text:
Lina: Heads-up on MAVRIK POC cutover — need final owners for networking, auth, and PR review. Proposed cutover Thu 4/15 09:00 PT. Can owners confirm?

Omar: I can own model pin and traffic routing. PR here: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/482 — tagging @Carla for code review.

Carla: Reviewing now. Left a couple comments on batching config and a question about KV cache invalidation strategy (might affect warm-start perf). Pinged in PR.

Nick: VPC peering window is booked Wed 4/14 02:00 UTC. Need Mavrik to confirm CIDR allowlist (Maya). Also we'll need port 8080 opened between subnets.

Maya (Mavrik): Confirmed — CIDRs and contact sent to cust-network@mavrik.com. SAML metadata endpoint: https://idp.mavrik.com/metadata — can you confirm Redwood will fetch automatically or we push metadata?

Sam: Success criteria reminder from SOW: 1000 qps sustained for 15m with p50 <120ms, and no customer data persisted. I'll run the acceptance evals during the canary.

Lina: Carla + Omar + Nick — can you ack PR + infra by EOD Tue? Also please flag on-call if there are any infra reboot windows.

Carla: ack. quick repro for the failing unit test I mentioned:
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://staging.redwood/api/v1/predict -d '{"input":"test"}'
```
That returns a 502 when cache is cold.

Omar: Note — plan is to pin to model `rdx-v2-quant` for cost; routing policy will fallback to `rdx-v2-fp16` if latency spikes above 400ms. Will add routing rule to PR.

Nick: FYI deploy-bot will run a canary at the scheduled cutover. Need the peering confirmed before that.

deploy-bot: Canary started: https://deploys.redwood.internal/1234 status=running :rocket:

Sam: I'll kick off the smoke evals during the canary. @Carla can you add the `canary:mavrik-2026-04-15` tag to the PR so I can trigger the job?

Carla: done — PR updated with `canary: mavrik-2026-04-15`.

Lina: Great. Filing follow-ups: runbook doc (Sam), SAML config fetch method (Nick & Maya), PR merge (Carla), peering confirm (Maya). I'll send final cutover calendar invite and a short slack reminder 24h before. :thumbsup:

Maya (Mavrik): Thanks — will confirm peering and SAML fetch by EOD Tue.

Nick: acked. I'll post the network test results as soon as peering is up.

Carla: I'll finish the CR and merge once infra greenlights the peering tests.

Lina: perfect — tagging this thread "cutover-plan" for tracking. If anything blocks, drop in #eng-oncall and @oncall.
